title: PCR 2024:06 Electronic and electric equipment, and electronic components (non-construction)
program_operator: EPD International AB (The International EPD System)

document.status_note: Validity taken from the document (v1.0.0 2024-10-28, v1.0.1 2024-12-09); current status on environdec.com not checked.

depends_on_unavailable: www.environdec.com/indicators - default list of mandatory/optional environmental performance indicators, methods and units (only GWP-GHG is named in the PCR itself)
EN 50693:2019 - Annex G (G.2/G.4 recovery-benefit rules, Table G.4 default material recovery rates) and Annex A (A.1 homogeneous-family extrapolation)
General Programme Instructions of the International EPD System (v4.0 cited as conformance basis; v5.0.0 rules partly adopted; latest GPI for verification)
Commission Regulation (EU) 2023/826 - operating mode definitions used in the TEC formula

rules.title: Construction products are out of scope
rules.requirement: Electronic/electric equipment or components that classify as construction products (EU CPR definition) are excluded; such products fall under PCR 2019:14.

rules.title: UN CPC division within PCR scope
rules.requirement: The product category corresponds to UN CPC divisions 43-48 and 84 (and HS code 85); the product's UN CPC division should fall in that range.

rules.title: Geographical scope declared
rules.requirement: The PCR may be used globally; the EPD must state the geographical location(s) of use and end-of-life for which performance was calculated.

rules.title: Functional or declared unit defined
rules.requirement: A functional unit (preferred) or, if not possible, a declared unit shall be clearly defined and documented in the EPD.

rules.title: Results expressed per functional/declared unit
rules.requirement: Environmental performance results shall be expressed per functional or declared unit.

rules.title: Functional unit states the function provided
rules.requirement: When a functional unit is used, it shall specify the function(s) the product provides to the user.

rules.title: Functional unit states the reference/performance level
rules.requirement: When a functional unit is used, it shall specify the reference or performance level(s) related to it.

rules.title: Declared unit only when a functional unit cannot be defined
rules.requirement: A declared unit may only be used when a functional unit cannot be defined (e.g. complex functions or multiple use scenarios of a component); the reason should be recorded.

rules.title: Declared unit is one item, one assembly, or one unit of a product property
rules.requirement: A declared unit shall equal one (1) item, one assembly of items, or one unit of a product property (e.g. 1 kg or 1 m).

rules.title: Declared unit detailed with item weight
rules.requirement: The declared unit shall be further detailed with relevant technical properties, including item weight (kg).

rules.title: Reference service life defined
rules.requirement: An RSL shall be defined for the product and stated in the EPD as part of the functional unit.

rules.title: RSL reference use conditions stated
rules.requirement: The properties and reference use conditions used to estimate the RSL shall be declared together with the RSL.

rules.title: RSL shown in product information
rules.requirement: The product information section shall state the RSL and/or technical/actual lifespan and applied standards, if relevant.

rules.title: Number of products needed over the RSL
rules.requirement: If the product's proven lifespan differs from the RSL, the quantity of product needed to fulfil the functional unit equals RSL divided by lifespan (e.g. 2 products for a 5-year lifespan and 10-year RSL).

rules.title: Scope is cradle-to-grave
rules.requirement: EPDs based on this PCR shall have cradle-to-grave scope.

rules.title: Four main life-cycle stages declared
rules.requirement: Results shall be divided into and declared for the manufacturing, distribution, use and end-of-life stages.

rules.title: Cradle-to-grave described in the EPD
rules.requirement: The product information section shall describe that the system boundary is cradle-to-grave and include a system diagram split by life-cycle stage.

rules.title: System diagram included
rules.requirement: The EPD shall include a system diagram of the processes in the LCA divided into life-cycle stages.

rules.title: Omitted life-cycle stages justified
rules.requirement: The EPD shall state which life-cycle stages (if any) are not considered, with a justification for the omission.

rules.title: 95% coverage of energy use
rules.requirement: All environmentally relevant processes should be included so that at least 95% of total energy use is accounted for.

rules.title: 95% coverage of product mass
rules.requirement: All environmentally relevant processes should be included so that at least 95% of the mass of product content is accounted for.

rules.title: Reject rates accounted for
rules.requirement: Reject rates (defective products) in manufacturing shall be accounted for in the LCA model.

rules.title: Warehouse storage energy covers at least 75% of product mass
rules.requirement: Upstream transport to a distribution point shall include energy for warehouse storage of raw materials/components covering at least 75% of the product mass.

rules.title: Component EPDs document use/end-of-life assumptions
rules.requirement: For components, assumptions (and their rationale) on use and end-of-life as part of a final product shall be communicated in the product information section.

rules.title: Capital goods inclusion described
rules.requirement: Infrastructure/capital goods are generally excluded; if included, the EPD shall describe it (stages/processes concerned) unless a sensitivity analysis shows <10% contribution to cradle-to-gate results for all declared impact indicators.

rules.title: Datasets containing capital goods named
rules.requirement: If capital goods are included via generic datasets whose full dataset contributes >5% to cradle-to-gate results of any impact indicator, the dataset name and source database shall be declared.

rules.title: Temporal boundary of 100 years
rules.requirement: By default, inputs and outputs shall be accounted for over 100 years from the year the LCA model best represents.

rules.title: Repair/reuse/refurbishment assumptions documented
rules.requirement: Repair, reuse and refurbishment are optional; if modelled, key assumptions shall be documented in the LCA report and the EPD.

rules.title: Cut-off limited to 5% over the life cycle
rules.requirement: The cut-off rule is 5% over the product life cycle: inputs/outputs known or expected to contribute more than 5% to any environmental performance indicator shall be included.

rules.title: Cut-offs described in the EPD
rules.requirement: Any application of cut-off rules, including the LCI data excluded, shall be described in the EPD.

rules.title: Components and materials that may never be cut off
rules.requirement: Batteries/accumulators, PCBA, electronic displays, gold, silver, copper and alloys, antimony trioxide, insulating gas (e.g. SF6), coolants, rare earths (indium, molybdenum, neodymium), microprocessors, magnesium anodes, tantalum capacitors and arsenic-gallium capacitors shall always be included.

rules.title: Co-product allocation follows the stepwise hierarchy
rules.requirement: Co-product allocation shall be avoided by subdivision where possible, otherwise based on physical properties, otherwise on economic value.

rules.title: Allocation choice justified
rules.requirement: When allocation by physical or economic properties is used, the reason the previous step of the hierarchy was not applicable should be documented.

rules.title: Waste allocation uses point of substitution
rules.requirement: Allocation of waste shall follow the point-of-substitution principle with cut-off allocation at the system boundary (differs from GPI and EN 15804 end-of-waste).

rules.title: EN 50693 Annex G rule stated when recovery occurs
rules.requirement: If there is any material/energy recovery, the EPD shall specify whether EN 50693 Annex G Section G.2 or G.4 rules were used.

rules.title: G.4 when benefits declared, G.2 when not
rules.requirement: If recovery benefits are declared, EN 50693 G.4 rules shall be followed; if they are not declared, G.2 rules shall be followed.

rules.title: Recovery benefits declared separately per stage
rules.requirement: Any calculated benefits from material/energy recovery shall be accounted for in the stage where recovery occurs and declared separately from the other results of each stage.

rules.title: Specific data reference year at most 5 years old
rules.requirement: The reference year of specific data shall not be more than five years old (representativeness reconfirmed by the data provider within five years).

rules.title: Specific data averaged over at least one year
rules.requirement: Specific data should be averaged over at least one year of operations; deviations shall be justified.

rules.title: Multi-site data weighted by production volume
rules.requirement: When data is averaged over several machines or manufacturing sites, production volume per site shall be accounted for (shares sum to 100%).

rules.title: Generic data reference year at most 10 years old
rules.requirement: Selected generic data shall not represent a reference year older than 10 years.

rules.title: Generic datasets are attributional
rules.requirement: Selected generic datasets shall be based on attributional modelling (no marginal data, no system-expansion credits).

rules.title: Database version no older than two years
rules.requirement: Datasets should come from the latest database version; otherwise the version shall not be older than two years from publication of the EPD.

rules.title: Proxy data at most 10% of impacts
rules.requirement: Environmental impacts associated with proxy data shall not exceed 10% of the overall environmental impact of the product system.

rules.title: Share of specific data declared
rules.requirement: The EPD shall declare the share of specific data contributing to manufacturing-stage GWP-GHG results (">90%" may be reported above 90%).

rules.title: Share-of-specific-data explanatory statement
rules.requirement: Next to the share of specific data, the EPD shall include the prescribed statement that it is calculated from GWP-GHG results and is a simplified data-quality indicator not comparable across product categories.

any_of: share of specific data is calculated based on GWP-GHG results

rules.title: Data-quality summary when proxy data used
rules.requirement: If proxy data is used, the EPD shall include a summary of the data quality declaration, including why the proxy data does not meet requirements.

rules.title: Consumer packaging modelled with specific data when required
rules.requirement: Specific data shall be used for consumer packaging production if under the organisation's direct control or if it exceeds 10% of product indicator results.

rules.title: Use-stage measurement standards cited
rules.requirement: Existing standards for measurement/test methods shall justify use-stage calculations, and these normative references shall be mentioned in the EPD.

rules.title: Data years declared
rules.requirement: The product information section shall declare the year(s) covered by the data used in the LCA and other relevant reference years.

rules.title: Databases referenced with version
rules.requirement: The main database(s) for generic data and their versions shall be referenced in the EPD, if relevant.

rules.title: LCA software referenced
rules.requirement: The LCA software used shall be referenced in the EPD, if relevant.

rules.title: Manufacturing electricity follows the modelling hierarchy
rules.requirement: Electricity in processes modelled with specific data shall be modelled in priority: (1) supplier-specific mix backed by Guarantee of Origin or similar, (2) residual mix, (3) consumption mix of the market.

rules.title: No consumption mix under direct control when residual mix is public
rules.requirement: The consumption-mix option shall not be used for processes under the EPD owner's direct control as long as the residual grid mix composition is publicly disclosed.

rules.title: Manufacturing electricity mix documented
rules.requirement: The electricity mix used in manufacturing/production processes shall be documented in the EPD, where relevant.

rules.title: Use-stage electricity uses market consumption mix
rules.requirement: Electricity used in the region/country of use shall be modelled with the electricity consumption mix of that market.

rules.title: Sales-weighted use-stage electricity for multiple markets
rules.requirement: When the product is used in two or more markets with distinct electricity mixes, sales shares per market shall weight use-stage electricity (shares sum to 100%).

rules.title: Use-stage electricity mix composition declared
rules.requirement: The product information section shall declare the use-stage electricity mix (percentage per source).

rules.title: Use-stage electricity emission factor declared
rules.requirement: The product information section shall declare the emission factor of the use-stage electricity mix.

rules.title: Total energy consumption (TEC) formula
rules.requirement: For equipment continuously connected to mains, TEC may be calculated as the sum over modes (on, off, standby, networked standby, other) of power x daily time, multiplied over the RSL (worked example: x 365 days x RSL years).

check.expression: ((scenarios.use.p_on_w * scenarios.use.t_on_h) + (scenarios.use.p_off_w * scenarios.use.t_off_h) + (scenarios.use.p_standby_w * scenarios.use.t_standby_h) + (scenarios.use.p_net_standby_w * scenarios.use.t_net_standby_h) + (scenarios.use.p_other_w * scenarios.use.t_other_h)) * scenarios.use.days_per_year * rsl_years / 1000

rules.title: Mode times sum to 24 hours
rules.requirement: The time spent in each operating mode per day should sum to 24 hours and reflect normal operating conditions.

rules.title: ICT infrastructure energy reported separately
rules.requirement: When ICT-infrastructure energy use is included, its impacts shall be reported separately from the direct use impacts of the product.

rules.title: Distribution transport data basis
rules.requirement: Transport to the customer shall use, in priority, actual modes/distances for a specific customer or market, else a weighted average over several customers/markets.

rules.title: Distribution transport described
rules.requirement: The transport of the product to the customer shall be described in the EPD, where relevant.

rules.title: End-of-life key assumptions documented
rules.requirement: Key assumptions for the end-of-life scenario shall be documented in the LCA report and in the EPD.

rules.title: GWP-GHG declared for all mandatory stages
rules.requirement: In addition to the default environdec indicator list, the EPD shall declare GWP-GHG (GWP-total with biogenic CO2 characterisation factor set to zero) per stage and in aggregate; ND is not allowed for mandatory indicators.

rules.title: LCIA methods reported with source and version
rules.requirement: The source and version of the impact assessment methods and characterisation factors shall be reported in the EPD.

rules.title: Default environdec indicator list version recorded
rules.requirement: The EPD shall declare the default environmental performance indicators listed on www.environdec.com/indicators; the list version applied should be recorded for verification.

rules.title: Aggregated result equals sum of stages
rules.requirement: Results shall be declared per life-cycle stage and in aggregated form; the aggregate should equal the sum of declared stages (shown for GWP-GHG, apply to every indicator).

rules.title: No normalisation results
rules.requirement: Results of normalisation are not allowed in the EPD.

rules.title: Three significant figures
rules.requirement: Three significant figures should be adopted for all results; the number of significant digits shall be appropriate and consistent.

rules.title: English version or English executive summary
rules.requirement: If the EPD is not available in English, it shall contain an executive summary in English (subject to verification).

rules.title: EPD validity of at most five years
rules.requirement: An EPD shall be valid for five years from the date of the verification report (approval date).

rules.title: Issued while the PCR is valid
rules.requirement: The EPD should be issued within the validity of PCR 2024:06 (valid until 2029-10-28).

rules.title: Grouping option for multiple products
rules.requirement: An EPD covering several similar products shall use one of: production-weighted average, a representative product, or worst-case results.

rules.title: Average weighted by production volume
rules.requirement: Average results shall be weighted according to production volumes of the included products, if relevant.

rules.title: Representative product choice justified
rules.requirement: If a representative product is used, its choice shall be justified in the EPD (e.g. by production volume).

rules.title: Variation above 10% declared
rules.requirement: If impact results differ by more than 10% between included products, the EPD shall declare the variation for each indicator exceeding 10%.

rules.title: Multiple-product statement and list on cover
rules.requirement: EPDs covering multiple products shall state so on the cover page and list all products covered.

rules.title: Content declaration representation explained
rules.requirement: EPDs of multiple products or sector EPDs shall describe what the content declaration represents.

rules.title: Sector EPD lists contributing manufacturers
rules.requirement: A sector EPD shall list the contributing manufacturers it covers.

rules.title: Sector EPD selection and averaging described
rules.requirement: A sector EPD shall describe how sites/products were selected and how the average was determined.

rules.title: Sector EPD representativeness percentage
rules.requirement: A sector EPD shall state it covers average values for an entire/partial category, specifying the percentage of representativeness.

rules.title: Sector EPD 'not available for purchase' statement
rules.requirement: A sector EPD shall state that the declared product is an average not available for purchase on the market, and the cover page shall state it is a Sector EPD.

rules.title: Trader EPD transport based on specific data
rules.requirement: A trader EPD shall include transport from manufacturer(s) to central warehouse or market border (and to the retail store, for retailers), based on specific data.

rules.title: Trader packaging based on specific data
rules.requirement: If the trader uses its own packaging, its production shall be included based on specific data.

rules.title: Section present: Cover page
rules.requirement: The EPD reporting format shall include a 'Cover page' section.

rules.title: Section present: Programme information
rules.requirement: The EPD reporting format shall include a 'Programme information' section.

rules.title: Section present: Product information
rules.requirement: The EPD reporting format shall include a 'Product information' section.

rules.title: Section present: Content declaration
rules.requirement: The EPD reporting format shall include a 'Content declaration' section.

rules.title: Section present: Environmental performance
rules.requirement: The EPD reporting format shall include a 'Environmental performance' section.

rules.title: Section present: Additional environmental information
rules.requirement: The EPD reporting format shall include a 'Additional environmental information' section.

rules.title: Section present: Additional social and economic information
rules.requirement: The EPD reporting format shall include a 'Additional social and economic information' section.

rules.title: Section present: References
rules.requirement: The EPD reporting format shall include a 'References' section.

rules.title: Differences versus previous versions
rules.requirement: Updated EPDs shall include a description of differences versus previously published versions.

rules.title: Revision date on cover for updated EPDs
rules.requirement: Updated EPDs shall show a revision date on the cover page.

rules.title: Product name on cover
rules.requirement: The cover page shall include the product name.

rules.title: Product image on cover
rules.requirement: The cover page shall include a product image.

rules.title: EPD owner name and logotype on cover
rules.requirement: The cover page shall include the name and logotype of the EPD owner.

rules.title: 'Environmental Product Declaration' on cover
rules.requirement: The cover page shall include the text 'Environmental Product Declaration' and/or 'EPD'.

rules.title: Programme named on cover
rules.requirement: The cover page shall name the programme: The International EPD System, www.environdec.com.

rules.title: Programme operator is EPD International AB
rules.requirement: The programme operator shall be EPD International AB.

rules.title: Registration number from the programme operator
rules.requirement: The cover page shall show the EPD registration number issued by the programme operator.

rules.title: Date of publication on cover
rules.requirement: The cover page shall show the date of publication (issue).

rules.title: Validity date on cover
rules.requirement: The cover page shall show the date of validity.

rules.title: Validity note on cover
rules.requirement: The cover page shall note that the stated validity is subject to continued registration and publication on www.environdec.com.

any_of: subject to the continued registration and publication

rules.title: Conformity with ISO 14025 stated
rules.requirement: The cover page shall state conformity with ISO 14025.

rules.title: Conformity with EN 50693 stated
rules.requirement: The cover page shall state conformity with EN 50693.

rules.title: Programme operator address
rules.requirement: The programme information shall give the address of EPD International AB (Box 210 60, SE-100 31 Stockholm, Sweden) and support e-mail.

rules.title: Comparability statement
rules.requirement: The programme information shall include the prescribed ISO 14025-based statement on comparability of EPDs.

any_of: from different programmes may not be comparable

rules.title: Sole ownership statement
rules.requirement: The programme information shall state that the EPD owner has sole ownership, liability and responsibility for the EPD.

rules.title: EN 50693 as core PCR statement
rules.requirement: The PCR information table shall state that CEN standard EN 50693 serves as the core PCR.

rules.title: PCR name, registration number and version
rules.requirement: The PCR used shall be identified by name, registration number (2024:06) and version (and UN CPC codes); any reference to the PCR shall include registration number, name and version.

rules.title: PCR review chair stated
rules.requirement: The PCR information shall name the PCR review chair and how to contact them via the programme operator.

rules.title: Third-party verification
rules.requirement: The declaration and data shall be externally and independently (third-party) verified per ISO 14025, following the latest GPI verification rules.

rules.title: Verification route stated
rules.requirement: The verification information shall indicate individual EPD verification, EPD Process Certification, or a pre-verified LCA/EPD tool.

rules.title: Third-party verifier named
rules.requirement: The name and organisation of the verifier (or certification body) shall be stated, with approval/accreditation.

rules.title: Pre-verified tool named
rules.requirement: If a pre-verified LCA/EPD tool is used, its name and version and tool verifier shall be stated.

rules.title: Follow-up procedure declared
rules.requirement: The verification table shall state (Yes/No) whether the follow-up of data during EPD validity involves a third-party verifier.

rules.title: EPD owner address and contact
rules.requirement: Product information shall include address and contact information of the EPD owner.

rules.title: Description of the organisation
rules.requirement: Product information shall include a description of the organisation.

rules.title: Production site location (city)
rules.requirement: Product information shall give the location of the production site(s), at minimum the city or municipality.

rules.title: Unambiguous product identification
rules.requirement: The product shall be identified by name and unambiguously by standards, concessions or other means.

rules.title: UN CPC code declared
rules.requirement: The product shall be identified according to the UN CPC scheme (other codes such as CPV, UNSPSC, NACE/CPA, ANZSIC, GTIN may be added).

rules.title: Product description
rules.requirement: Product information shall include a description of the product.

rules.title: Technical purpose and intended use
rules.requirement: Product information shall describe the technical purpose of the product including its application/intended use.

rules.title: Background system description
rules.requirement: Product information shall describe the background system, including the main technological aspects.

rules.title: Mass of one product unit declared
rules.requirement: The mass of one unit of product, as purchased or per declared unit, shall be declared.

rules.title: Materials and substances listed with mass
rules.requirement: The content declaration shall list materials and substances with their mass (confidential items may be generic terms or reasonable ranges).

rules.title: Packaging mass and content declared
rules.requirement: The mass and content of distribution and/or consumer packaging shall be declared, when applicable.

rules.title: Content declaration covers 100% of product mass
rules.requirement: The gross mass in the content declaration shall cover 100% of one unit of product (and its packaging).

rules.title: Biogenic content above 5% declared with biogenic carbon
rules.requirement: If biogenic content exceeds 5% of the product, its mass-% and the biogenic carbon content (kg C per unit) shall be declared.

rules.title: Post-consumer recycled content above 5% declared
rules.requirement: If post-consumer recycled content exceeds 5%, this share shall be declared; pre-consumer content, if declared, shall be shown separately.

rules.title: Packaging biogenic content above 5% declared
rules.requirement: If biogenic content in the packaging exceeds 5%, this share shall be declared.

rules.title: SVHCs above 0.1% declared
rules.requirement: Substances on the ECHA SVHC candidate list exceeding 0.1% of product weight shall be declared with their environmental/hazardous properties, regardless of LCA cut-off.

rules.title: GPI with version referenced
rules.requirement: The reference section shall list the GPI, including version number.

rules.title: PCR referenced in references section
rules.requirement: The reference section shall list the PCR (registration number, name and version) used.

manual_checks.title: Applicable c-PCR used
manual_checks.reason: Whether a published c-PCR applies to the product category (and must then be used, with its functional unit) depends on the current environdec.com c-PCR list.

manual_checks.title: Excluded product categories covered by other PCRs
manual_checks.reason: Bearings (CPC 433), lifts (43540), motors/generators (46112, 46131), air-conditioners (43912), special-purpose machinery (449), liquid-food filling (439211), machine-tools (44214, 44211), construction-sector cables (463, 41513, 41533) are generally excluded unless WEEE-classified and EN 50693 compliance is sought; needs judgement.

manual_checks.title: Product meets EEE/component definition
manual_checks.reason: EEE defined as dependent on electric currents with voltage rating <=1000 V AC / <=1500 V DC; components defined separately. Classification requires expert judgement.

manual_checks.title: Functional unit captures the function quantitatively
manual_checks.reason: Whether the defined functional unit adequately captures the product function(s) cannot be evaluated automatically.

manual_checks.title: Declared unit technical properties where relevant
manual_checks.reason: Item size, unit of operation and rated input/output (V, Hz, A, W) are required 'where relevant'; relevance needs judgement.

manual_checks.title: RSL estimation basis and PEP PSR RSLs considered
manual_checks.reason: RSL should follow harmonised product standards; PEP Ecopassport PSR RSLs shall be considered for products in their scope. Needs expert review.

manual_checks.title: Installation and de-installation stages included if relevant
manual_checks.reason: Installation and de-installation stages are mandatory only 'if relevant'.

manual_checks.title: Required manufacturing processes included
manual_checks.reason: Inclusion of PCB components/energy for electronic devices, regular product testing, packaging, internal transport, manufacturing waste EoL must be verified against the inventory.

manual_checks.title: Excluded processes not included
manual_checks.reason: Capital goods (with exceptions), service facilities, business travel, commuting, R&D/marketing shall not be included; requires inventory inspection.

manual_checks.title: Cut-off justified by sensitivity analysis
manual_checks.reason: Exclusions must be based on sensitivity analysis/conservative assumptions documented verifiably in the LCA report; cut-offs shall not hide data.

manual_checks.title: Economic allocation sensitivity analysis
manual_checks.reason: If economic allocation is used, the LCA report shall include a sensitivity analysis on the economic values chosen.

manual_checks.title: Point of substitution criteria and hazardous waste
manual_checks.reason: Whether recovered flows meet all five point-of-substitution criteria, conservative assumptions when unknown, and hazardous waste assignment require judgement.

manual_checks.title: Specific data prioritised; on-site data for controlled processes
manual_checks.reason: Specific data shall be prioritised and processes under direct management control shall use on-site specific data; requires review of data sources.

manual_checks.title: Generic data representativeness and EN 50693 Annex A extrapolation
manual_checks.reason: Technological/geographical/temporal coverage of generic data and use of Annex A extrapolation need expert review.

manual_checks.title: Data quality assessment in LCA report
manual_checks.reason: LCA report shall assess precision, completeness, representativeness, consistency and boundary alignment per ISO 14044, and show share-of-specific-data calculations.

manual_checks.title: Use-stage data representativeness
manual_checks.reason: Use-stage data shall be specific where available, otherwise manufacturer default settings; emissions based on recognised tests; actual documented use overrides defaults.

manual_checks.title: Operating modes and peak/nominal power considered
manual_checks.reason: Evaluation of non-on modes and nominal/peak power distribution (EN 50564/EN 50643) should be included; needs review.

manual_checks.title: End-of-life scenario practicable and regulation-compliant
manual_checks.reason: EoL scenario shall be technically/economically practicable and not contradict collection, recycling or landfill rules in the EPD's geography; EN 50693 Table G.4 rates are reference defaults.

manual_checks.title: Additional indicators justified and explained
manual_checks.reason: Additional indicators/alternative LCIA methods require justification and an explanation of differences; extra inventory data only in an annex.

manual_checks.title: Representative product requires homogeneous family; grouping justified
manual_checks.reason: Homogeneity (same function, standards, technology) and LCA-report justification for >10% variation require judgement.

manual_checks.title: Sector EPD communication not attributed to a manufacturer
manual_checks.reason: Sector EPD results shall not be claimed representative of a manufacturer; same PCR and unit for all covered products.

manual_checks.title: Trader EPD based on manufacturer EPD of same PCR major version
manual_checks.reason: Underlying manufacturer EPD must use same PCR first-digit version, be accessible to the verifier, and trigger re-verification when updated.

manual_checks.title: EPD content not misleading; no ratings or comparisons
manual_checks.reason: Content shall follow ISO 14020, be verifiable/accurate/relevant and contain no ratings, judgements or direct comparisons; machine-readable versions shall match.

manual_checks.title: Results table cell rules
manual_checks.reason: Result tables may only contain values or 'ND' (ND not allowed for mandatory indicators), no blanks/hyphens/</>; '0' only when calculated as zero; footnotes for limitations. No check type validates per-cell content.

manual_checks.title: SI units, number style and ISO 8601 dates
manual_checks.reason: SI units, SI-style thousand separator/decimal mark (state symbols if confusing) and YYYY-MM-DD dates; no suitable check type for formats.

manual_checks.title: Images used with caution
manual_checks.reason: Nature imagery unrelated to the product may be an environmental claim; requires judgement.

manual_checks.title: Regional hub and dual registration information
manual_checks.reason: Regional hub references and dual-registration details apply only where applicable.

manual_checks.title: No certification-body registration number
manual_checks.reason: The EPD shall not show a certification-body 'registration number' that could be confused with the programme operator's.

manual_checks.title: Verification disclaimer
manual_checks.reason: Table 5 says to 'include disclaimer in all cases' but the disclaimer text is not given in the PCR (GPI dependency).

manual_checks.title: Content declaration consistency, SVHC screening, 'free-of' claims
manual_checks.reason: Consistency with technical data sheet, SDS availability to verifier, actual (not dataset) recycled/biogenic shares, regulated hazardous substances per market, and 'free of' claims require review.

manual_checks.title: Additional environmental/social information substantiated
manual_checks.reason: Additional information shall be substantiated, verifiable, not misleading; alternative use/EoL scenarios only in additional information; EMI/EMC info recommended.

manual_checks.title: EPD update after significant change
manual_checks.reason: EPD shall be updated and re-verified (or de-registered) if any impact indicator rises >=10%, errors are found, or declared information changes significantly; requires annual follow-up comparison.

manual_checks.title: Capital goods inclusion exceptions
manual_checks.reason: Whether capital goods meet the single-use or non-separable-dataset exceptions requires judgement.

notes: Life-cycle stages: this PCR is not an EN 15804 PCR. Stage keys used in `scenarios.<stage>`, `results.<method>.<indicator>.<stage>`, `results.modules_declared[]` and in `modules_required`/`indicators_required` are: manufacturing (maps to A1-A3), distribution (A4), installation (A5, if relevant), use (B1-B7; repair/reuse/refurbishment optional), de_installation (C1, if relevant), end_of_life (C2-C4), plus `total` for the aggregated result. There is no module D: recovery benefits are declared separately per stage (path `results.recovery_benefits`). (§4.3.1, Table 2, p15-16)

Table 2 (p15-16) labels both 'De-installation' and 'End of life' as 'Module C1-C4', but the sub-modules list C1 for de-installation and C2-C4 for end-of-life; the mapping above follows the sub-modules.

Indicators: the PCR does not list indicators itself; it requires the default list on www.environdec.com/indicators (not provided) plus GWP-GHG (kg CO2 eq.). Only GWP-GHG is encoded in indicators_required (PCR2024-06.IND.01); the adapter must add the environdec default indicator set (version recorded in lca.indicator_list_version) before this ruleset is complete. Use of resources mandatory indicators (§5.4.5.2) and optional waste/output-flow indicators (§5.4.5.3) are likewise defined only on that website.

Results method key `environdec_default` is used in results paths. Indicator keys in paths are lowercase snake_case of the abbreviation (e.g. GWP-GHG -> gwp_ghg) because '-' is the minus operator in expressions; `indicators_required` entries carry both display `name` and path `key`.

Schema extension: some rules carry an optional rule-level `applies_when` expression; the rule should be evaluated only when it is true (otherwise skipped/not applicable). Expressions here also use single-quoted string literals, true/false, and a bare path that evaluates true when non-empty (same semantics as required_field). Engine support for these is needed.

TEC formula (§4.7.5.2 p28) as printed omits the days-per-year factor and Wh->kWh conversion, while the worked example (p29: (80 W x 4 h + 0.5 W x 20 h) x 365 d x 7 y = 843.15 kWh) includes them; USE.01 encodes the example's form. The PCR presents the formula as optional ('can be taken into consideration') and states the energy-consumption section does not apply to electronic components. The Pon definition erroneously lists all modes, and 'Tstandy' is a typo.

Cut-off ambiguity (§4.5 p20): the rule is '5% over the product life cycle' yet also says each input/output contributing >5% to any indicator shall be included; CO.01 encodes both per-flow and total 5% on an impact basis. The 95% energy/mass coverage (§4.3 p15) is a 'should'.
Copper and alloys are on the never-cut-off list (§4.5 p21) - highly relevant for cables.

Residual mix is defined against the 'total consumption mix' in §4.7.5.1 but against the 'total production mix' in §4.7.5.2 (p27); the use stage nevertheless mandates the consumption mix, so the residual-mix text there appears to be leftover.
Consumer packaging rule (§4.7.5.1 p26) says '>10% of all product environmental indicators' results' - unclear whether 'all' or 'any' indicator; DQ.11 uses a single share field.

RSL (§4.2 p14) is required for 'an EPD developed based on this PCR' as part of the functional unit; it is unclear whether declared-unit EPDs of components must also state an RSL. RSL.01 is applied to all EPDs.
Content declaration (§5.4.4 p37) is required 'if relevant' and the PCR was meant to specify when it is not relevant, but it does not; treat as required unless explicitly marked not relevant.

GPI version inconsistency: standards conformance lists GPI 4.02 (p7) and §3.3 says developed per GPI 4.0, while p6 and footnotes reference GPI 5.0.0; verification follows the latest GPI. IEC 63366 is mistyped as IEC 63666 in §1.3 (p5) and EN 50693 as EN 50694 in §3.3 (p10); references list EN 50693:2022 whereas elsewhere EN 50693:2019.

Waste allocation intentionally deviates from GPI/EN 15804: point-of-substitution (EN 50693) instead of polluter-pays/end-of-waste (footnote 6 p10, Annex 2 p47-48). Conformance to this PCR does not ensure EN 15804+A2 conformance.
§5.4.3 product-information optional list ends with a dangling 'and' (p37) - possibly a truncated item.
Version 1.0.1 only corrected footnote 16 (p26) to refer to the third (not fourth) electricity option.
